title: Zero PSB locker thefts in FY26
summary: For the first time, all PSBs reported zero locker theft cases in FY26, after 40 cases over the previous 4 years.

blocks.content: For the first time, all PSBs reported zero locker theft cases in FY26, after 40 cases over the previous 4 years.

items: 40 theft cases across 12 PSBs (FY22–FY25); 1,11,11,077 PSB lockers operational (31 Mar 2026)
Highest theft (bank): Bank of India & Central Bank of India — 14 each | Highest (state): UP (18), Jharkhand (12)
RBI mandate: CCTV at strong-room entry/exit, footage kept ≥180 days
